title: Freeze the 24 original native-only regression controls
description: Run the original 24 native-only claims from the 187-claim November benchmark. Keep every staged JBMC and strict native result, including comparator disagreements, against the independent historical observer, the full int domain and the original per-claim budget.
expected: All 24 original native controls are compared on both engines with 120-second deadlines and their replay outcomes recorded.
